reader.requirement: At 85 one USE statement may reference, explicitly by file-name list or implicitly through INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O or EXTEND, files of different organizations (sequential, relative, indexed) and access modes (sequential, random, dynamic), and the one procedure must run for each referenced file's qualifying condition.

edition-consulted.switches: the 1985 required words AFTER and PROCEDURE and the 2002 Formats 3/4; nothing about the files' organization
DialectLevel >= 2002 SORT GR17 exit filter; not organization-dependent

reader.edition-search: DeclBindUse's file loop checks only visibility and sort/merge files (no organization or access test, no edition test); grep of DialectLevel in the dispatch emitters
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf28_02 mixes relative-sequential and indexed-random explicitly and sequential plus relative-random under INPUT; dynamic access and an indexed file under a mode USE, and the open-failure path of a mode USE across organizations, are covered only by the probe

probes.printed: D1 (ON FS FR FX: sequential, relative random, indexed dynamic) fires for FS open 35, FR read 23, FX read 23; D2 (EXCEPTION ON INPUT) fires for FM (relative sequential) and FN (indexed random) failed opens; D3 (ERROR ON I-O) fires for both on OPEN I-O
probes.expected: one procedure per USE runs for every referenced file whatever its organization or access (§1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR5 a, b, d), and control returns after each non-critical status (GR6)
a sequential file under the outer INPUT USE and a relative file under the contained program's own INPUT USE each reach their own program's declarative (§1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR1)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.8.3 SR5  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: DeclBindUse resolves each named file against the visible files and refuses only an unknown or a sort/merge file; mode-scoped USEs carry no file list at all and are matched at run time by the connector's open (or being-opened) mode, so mixing organizations is never compared. Probes exercise the explicit and implicit forms across all three organizations and three access modes.

refuter.evidence: r1ext-002: USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE ON FQ FR FX (sequential, relative sequential, indexed sequential) compiled and satisfied the INVALID KEY/AT END requirement for every file; r3err-001: mode USEs reach relative dynamic and relative sequential files (DO 22, DI 23, DIO 23); r1order-001: USE ERROR ON INPUT fires for a relative random file in an OPEN beside sequential and indexed dynamic files. Class c (IPC GLOBAL): r5nestg-001, one USE GLOBAL ERROR ON INPUT in the container serves a sequential file in the container and an indexed dynamic file in a contained program with no declaratives, while a relative random file in a contained program with its own INPUT USE takes that one (§1985:X.5.5.4 GR1a): OUTER-GLOBAL-INPUT STO=35 STI=ZZ / INNER-INPUT STI=35 / OUTER-GLOBAL-INPUT STO=35 STI=35. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.8.3 SR5; OK §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1.
